_comment: The Setup wizard's own texts. %1 is filled in by the wizard; %n is a line break; & marks the Alt-key letter of a button (keep one & per button text). [name] and [name/ver] are filled in by Inno Setup. Keep 'Hearthstone Deck Tracker', 'HDT', 'HearthstoneDeckTracker.exe' and 'F3' as they are.

messages.WelcomeLabel2: This will install [name/ver] into Hearthstone Deck Tracker's plugin folder for the current user.%n%nHearthstone Deck Tracker is closed while the files are copied; Setup can start it again at the end.
messages.ReadyLabel2a: Click Install to continue. Setup closes Hearthstone Deck Tracker if it is running, installs the plugin and, on a first install, switches it on.
messages.FinishedLabelNoIcons: [name] is installed and starts together with Hearthstone Deck Tracker.%n%nWhile HDT runs, press F3 to open the card search; the rest appears over Hearthstone in a Battlegrounds match. The first launch downloads card art in the background (about 200 MB, once).
messages.FinishedLabel: [name] is installed and starts together with Hearthstone Deck Tracker.%n%nWhile HDT runs, press F3 to open the card search; the rest appears over Hearthstone in a Battlegrounds match. The first launch downloads card art in the background (about 200 MB, once).

custom.HdtPageDescription: The toolkit is a plugin: it runs inside Hearthstone Deck Tracker (HDT).
custom.HdtIntro: It has no window or desktop icon of its own and starts together with HDT, the free deck tracker. Setup installs it only once HDT is on this PC.
custom.HdtFoundNext: Click Next to continue. Setup closes Hearthstone Deck Tracker while it copies the files and can start it again at the end.
custom.HdtNotFound: Hearthstone Deck Tracker was not found on this PC
custom.HdtNotFoundSteps: 1. Click Download HDT and install Hearthstone Deck Tracker from its website. Its installer starts HDT when it is done; leave it running.%n2. Come back to this window and click Check again.%n%nAlready have HDT and Setup still cannot find it? Click Locate HDT and pick HearthstoneDeckTracker.exe in the folder where HDT is.
custom.SrcPrevious: the previous install of this toolkit
custom.HdtBrowserFailed: Could not open the browser. Go to %1 to download Hearthstone Deck Tracker.
custom.HdtStillNotFound: Hearthstone Deck Tracker is still not found.%n%nIf you have just installed it, start it once and click Check again. If it is installed in a folder of your own, click Locate HDT and pick HearthstoneDeckTracker.exe.
custom.HdtNotHdt: That is not Hearthstone Deck Tracker.%n%nPick the file named HearthstoneDeckTracker.exe in the folder where HDT is installed.
custom.HdtInstallFirst: Install Hearthstone Deck Tracker first, then click Check again.
custom.LangPageDescription: Which language should the toolkit use?
custom.LangIntro: The card search, the cards and everything the toolkit shows over Hearthstone use this language. It does not have to match this window's language, and you can change it later in the toolkit's settings.
custom.HdtStillRunning: Hearthstone Deck Tracker is still running.%n%nClose it (if its window is hidden: right-click the HDT tray icon > Exit), then click Retry.
custom.HdtMissingSilent: Hearthstone Deck Tracker is not installed on this PC. The toolkit is a plugin that runs inside it: install HDT from %1, start it once, then run Setup again.
custom.HdtRunningAbort: Hearthstone Deck Tracker is still running. Close it and run Setup again.
custom.PluginSwitchedOn: The plugin is switched on in Hearthstone Deck Tracker.
custom.PluginSwitchOnHint: If it does not show up in Hearthstone Deck Tracker, switch it on under Options > Tracker > Plugins.
custom.ModePageDescription: On its own, or inside Hearthstone Deck Tracker.
custom.ModeStandaloneHint: Runs by itself over Hearthstone; no other app is needed. It has its own tray icon, settings and card search (F3).
custom.ModePluginHintFound: Starts together with HDT and draws in HDT's overlay. Hearthstone Deck Tracker is installed on this PC.
custom.ModePluginHintMissing: Starts together with HDT and draws in HDT's overlay. Hearthstone Deck Tracker is not installed yet; Setup helps you get it.
custom.ModeSwitchNote: Only one of the two can run. Choosing one switches the other off if it is installed; you can come back and choose the other at any time.
custom.AutoPageDescription: Choose how the toolkit should start.
custom.AutoYesHint: It waits in the tray, using next to nothing, until Hearthstone starts, then comes up by itself and closes again with the game. You can turn this off in its settings or in Task Manager (Startup apps).
custom.AutoNoHint: Start it from its shortcut each time you play.
custom.ReadyStartManualDesktop: from its desktop or Start menu shortcut
custom.ReadyStandalone: Click Install to continue. Setup closes the toolkit if it is running and, if the Hearthstone Deck Tracker plugin is installed, switches it off.
custom.FinishedStandalone: %1 is installed.%n%nIt shows over Hearthstone in a Battlegrounds match; press F3 for the card search, and find its settings at its tray icon. The first start downloads card art in the background (about 200 MB, once).
custom.FinishedAuto: It starts with Windows and waits for Hearthstone.
custom.FinishedManual: Start it from its shortcut when you play.
custom.PluginSwitchedOff: The Hearthstone Deck Tracker plugin is switched off, so the toolkit does not show twice. To go back, run Setup again and choose the plugin.
custom.ToolkitRunningAbort: The toolkit is still running. Exit it from its tray icon and run Setup again.
